data.one_liner: Base classes for communicating with a Serverpod backend via HTTP and WebSocket
data.what_it_does: Provides client-side abstractions for sending requests, receiving responses, and handling WebSocket streams to a Serverpod server. It includes serialization helpers and connection management.
use_when: You need to integrate a Flutter app with a Serverpod backend
You want type-safe request/response handling without custom code generation
You prefer a lightweight client over full-featured HTTP libraries
avoid_when: You need advanced HTTP features like interceptors, caching, or multipart uploads
You prefer a declarative networking approach with code generation
strengths: Lightweight and tightly coupled to Serverpod API
Supports both HTTP and WebSocket communication
weaknesses: No built-in support for advanced HTTP features
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import; no build_runner needed
